newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - November 22.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's edition of Daily Variety:

HOLLYWOOD - Seagram Co Ltd's MCA studio chiefs Frank Biondi and Ron Meyer will gather the conglomerate's division chiefs next month for an executive retreat and officially unveil the Seagram-owned conglomerate's new logo. They'll also announce MCA's change of its corporate brand name to Universal Studios.

NEW YORK - Jedd Palmer, Tele-Communications Inc senior VP of programming, hinted during a media briefing Thursday that cable networks such as Lifetime, VH1 and Court TV will find themselves losing even more slots on TCI systems over the next few months.
